source_observation: rewriteErasures writes a retired audit record and deletes the only active tombstone; consumeLedger/writeBatches then persist a delayed pre-erasure decision or outcome without consulting erasures. The committed F06 verifier reproduced a visible permanent row after rewrite retirement and also while a pending rewrite had already passed that day. isLedgerMessage accepts an ID carrier without checking record tenant/time/visitor fields.
reproduction_basis: Current source-confirmed against the same behavior and the repository's committed independent F06 R1-R3 reproduction. New tests must inspect R2 rows and active barriers; no separate broad baseline run.
limits: Does not prove strict concurrent write fencing, shopper generation revocation, deployed R2 behavior, approved retention, physical completion SLA, customer acceptance or release.
